description: This file contains the server-side logic for handling a theoretical exam page in an online examination system. It manages loading questions from a database, handling user navigation, submitting answers to the database, and managing the exam timer.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the TheoryExam ASP.NET Web Form handling the logic for presenting theory questions, submitting answers, and managing the exam timer.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event, retrieves questions from the database, initializes the timer, and manages session validation.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns the full course name based on the course ID.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the User Profile page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Saves the user's answers into the database, updates course queues, and marks the course as taken.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the countdown timer display and handles time-out scenario.
